rule_or_requirement: The exact locally packaged pixel agent must complete real finish-line crossings at least as often as the selected control on new matched conditions.
observable_information: The two immutable ZIP byte streams, grayscale simulator observations, local finish flag, lap time, collisions, damage, and action timing.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Extract each frozen ZIP in a clean Linux CPU directory and execute its Agent against identical tracks 1–3 and seeds 336–339 without changing package bytes.
expected_success_endpoint: Candidate finish count at least control finish count across twelve cells, faster median finished lap time if tied, finite actions, and valid runtime limits.
falsifier: Candidate lower finish count, invalid action, runtime limit breach, or tied completion without lower median finished lap time.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Twenty-four fresh paired episodes: two frozen ZIPs on tracks 1–3 crossed with seeds 336–339, at most 2,000 decisions per episode.
resource_and_risk_gate: Registered Linux CPU profile, 1,800-second operation limit and 120-second episode cap; one-time confirmation with no adjustment, website upload, official submission, or model confirmation.
